title: DeepResearchDecomposition
description: Decomposition contract emitted by the deep-research orchestrator at Phase 1 (Scoping), frozen at Checkpoint 1 alongside the Output + Search contracts. Splits the research question into bounded sub-questions, each carrying the four delegation fields Anthropic's multi-agent research system requires (objective, output_format, source_guidance, boundary). Feeds the Phase 3 parallel sub-question fan-out. Built by scripts/decomposition_contract.py; validated by scripts/validate_sidecar.py --kind decomposition + predicates D1-D3.

schema_version.description: Decomposition schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the decomposition was frozen at Checkpoint 1.

mode.description: Active deep-research mode. Only search-running modes produce a decomposition.

topic_slug.description: Topic slug used in the report filename (e.g. 'kras-inhibitors').

complexity.description: Query complexity level driving fan-out width + per-subagent budget (thresholds.COMPLEXITY_SCALING).

rq.description: Research question text from Phase 1 scoping.

scaling.description: Effort-scaling envelope resolved from complexity (thresholds.COMPLEXITY_SCALING), with fan_out capped to 1 outside thresholds.FANOUT_MODES.

fan_out_width.description: Number of sub-question researchers (must equal len(sub_questions); predicate D2).

fanout_eligible.description: True when mode is in thresholds.FANOUT_MODES (Phase 3 spawns real subagents); False means single-context execution.

SubQuestion.description: One bounded sub-question handed to a researcher (subagent in fan-out modes, sequential pass otherwise). All four delegation fields are mandatory and non-empty (predicate D3) — vague tasks cause duplicated work and coverage gaps.

id.description: Stable sub-question id (SQ1, SQ2, ...). Unique within sub_questions (predicate D1).

objective.description: What this sub-question must answer — a specific, self-contained research goal.

output_format.description: What the researcher returns (e.g. 'annotated sources + 2-sentence finding per theme').

source_guidance.description: Which databases / tools / source types to favor for this slice.

boundary.description: Explicit scope limit — what this sub-question does NOT cover, to prevent overlap with siblings.
